_avail.description: 19" mixing amplifier 70 - 100 volt / 240 watts, 2 mic/line, 4 stereo line inputs, left to right 4 level priority system, Emergency in, paging mic with chime, 24V priority output
_avail.portsMissing: Not stated: priority-out and mains inlet connector types (set to other), and whether Pre Out and Rec Out share one Euroblock; the mute all and paging contacts are in the input notes, not separate ports

ports.label: Emergency In
ports.notes: Balanced 0 dBV line level, isolated; triggered by VOX or potential-free contact on the mute all connection; highest priority

ports.label: Paging Mic In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line on Euroblock; paging contact (potential-free) mutes lower priorities and plays chime

ports.label: Paging Line In (RCA)
ports.notes: Line level alternative for the paging input; mic/line switch

ports.label: Mic A In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line; +48 V phantom switchable; VOX

ports.label: Mic B In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line; +48 V phantom

ports.label: Input 1
ports.notes: Unbalanced stereo line, RCA pair, mono summed

ports.label: Input 2
ports.notes: Unbalanced stereo line, RCA pair, mono summed

ports.label: Input 3
ports.notes: Unbalanced stereo line, RCA pair, mono summed

ports.label: Input 4
ports.notes: Unbalanced stereo line, RCA pair, mono summed

ports.label: Pre Out
ports.notes: Line level 0 dBV after master volume; Euroblock

ports.label: Rec Out
ports.notes: Line level 0 dBV, not affected by front volume; Euroblock (shared with Pre Out not stated)

ports.label: Speaker Out
ports.notes: 4-pin 0.3 inch (7.6 mm) Euroblock: COM, 4 ohm, 70 V, 100 V; use one tap only

ports.label: Priority Out
ports.notes: 24 V DC, 0.5 A max when priority is active (emergency or paging); overrides volume controls on speaker lines; connector type not stated

ports.label: AC Power
ports.notes: 100-240 V AC mains inlet with power switch and fuse; inlet type not stated
